info.title: Harbor local API
info.description: Loopback-only administration API for the Harbor local preview. Bearer sessions; JSON only.

get.description: Daemon liveness only.
Whether this Harbor still needs its first administrator, plus what the setup wizard shows.

post.description: Create the first administrator (setup code from the installer required), optionally name the machine, and get a session. Refused once an administrator exists.

get.description: Installed version, newest release, and the state of an update in progress.

post.description: Ask GitHub Releases now whether a newer Harbor exists.
Update Harbor to the newest release: downloads, verifies, installs in place and restarts the daemon (the console reconnects).
Log in the local administrator. Rate limited. `remember` issues a 30-day session for this browser instead of the configured TTL.

get.description: Active sessions for this administrator (no token material; the current one is marked).

delete.description: Revoke every session except the current one.

get.description: Daemon/Docker availability.
Bundled packages.
Package presentation asset (icon/gallery) from the bundled package. Open (no session): static catalog content only.
Host metrics for the console (cpu, memory, disk, docker).
Volume disk usage grouped per app (docker system df, cached 60 s).
Notification history, newest first (persisting conditions are deduplicated).

post.description: Mark one notification read.
Mark every notification read.

get.description: External delivery channels (ntfy, webhook, email); secrets redacted.

put.description: Replace the delivery channels. A redacted secret ("••••") keeps the stored value.

post.description: Send a test notification to every configured channel.

get.description: Global automatic-update default for newly installed apps.

put.description: Set the global automatic-update default (opt-in; per-app toggles win).
Turn automatic updates for one app on or off.

post.description: Submit one update per app with a newer package revision (serial queue; per-app rollback).
Accept the folder at the recorded path as the new home for one storage claim (replacement drive or restored backup): stamps a fresh app-generated identity. The app must be stopped first.

get.description: Git repositories Harbor watches as app sources.

post.description: Add a git repository as an app source: fetch the branch, import harbor/ as a package (services may build from source; provenance is the commit).
Fetch the branch head now; a newer commit becomes a new package revision.

put.description: Turn redeploy-on-commit for this source on or off.

delete.description: Forget the repository link; the imported package and installed apps stay.

get.description: All instances including retained records.
Instance detail with safe events, resource roles and setup guidance.
Home widget data proxied from the app (decision 81); null when the app declares none or the data is unusable.
Cockpit/Portainer/Tailscale/proxy state and real links.
Published addresses (tailnet/public) of all instances.

put.description: Change the administrator password (current password required); every other session is revoked.

get.description: The administrator username (for the Home greeting) and whether two-factor login is on.

post.description: Start two-factor setup: returns a fresh secret (base32) and an otpauth URL for a QR code. Not active until enabled with a live code.
Confirm the new authenticator with its current code; two-factor login is on from now.
Turn two-factor login off (password required).

put.description: Name this machine (shown in Settings and on the login page); empty resets to the hostname.

get.description: Harbor's own recent log lines (systemd journal on a real host).
Recent container logs of one app.
Disks (mounts), removable devices, the Harbor data folder, folders in use by apps, and install locations for whole encrypted apps.
Subfolders of a host folder (system locations hidden).

post.description: Create one new folder inside a parent the Harbor service account may write to.
Mount a removable device to /mnt/<label> (root oneshot, polkit-allowed); poll GET /v1/host/storage for the result.
Unmount a removable device (refused while an app uses a folder on it).

get.description: Mount/unmount progress for one removable device.

put.description: Removable-drive behaviour: auto-mount on insert, auto-start apps whose drive came back (both on by default).

get.description: Registered public domains with DNS check results, this machine's public address and which app uses each domain.

post.description: Register a domain you own and check that its DNS points at this machine.
Re-check a registered domain's DNS.

delete.description: Forget a registered domain (refused while an app is published at it).

get.description: Wallpaper state (uploaded/rotating with attribution), rotation settings (no secrets) and the launcher order.
The current wallpaper picture (open: background art loaded by /CSS, which cannot send a token).

put.description: Set your own wallpaper: a PNG, JPEG or WebP picture as a data URL (max 6 MB).

Rotating wallpapers: turn on/off, choose the source (reddit needs your own Reddit app credentials; bing and wikimedia need none), subreddits and how often. Fetches the first picture right away when turning on.

post.description: Skip to the next rotating wallpaper now.

put.description: Launcher order (instance ids, first to last). Unknown ids are dropped; missing ones keep their default position.
Customise how an app appears on the launcher: display name and icon (default, an emoji/letters on a colour, or an uploaded picture up to 1 MB).

get.description: Custom launcher icon picture of an app (open: loaded by ).

post.description: Upload a package zip. Harbor validates it like a bundled package, pins tag images by digest at the registry and writes release.json. A higher revision of an already uploaded id becomes an update for its instances.

delete.description: Remove an uploaded package (refused while an app installed from it exists).

get.description: Hostname, OS, CPU and whether Harbor may restart or shut down this machine.

post.description: Restart or shut down the machine (apps come back on their own after a restart).
Log this host into a tailnet: with an auth key, or get a login URL to approve in a browser.
Log this host out of the tailnet (withdraws tailnet addresses).

put.description: Expose the Harbor UI on the tailnet (never publicly).

delete.description: Withdraw the tailnet exposure of the Harbor UI.

put.description: Bind an already installed tool by its loopback URL without taking ownership.

post.description: One-click install of Cockpit or Portainer from the console: starts the root oneshot (polkit-allowed); poll GET /v1/platform-tools for progress.
Create an immutable plan. Install: {kind, packageId, name?, storage?, location?}. Others: {kind, instanceId}.
Submit an exact plan ID. Requires Idempotency-Key. Install-location plans also need the encryption passphrase (never stored in the plan). Returns 202 with the (possibly existing) operation.

get.description: App homes found on mounted drives that this machine has not adopted (locked tiles; adopting prompts for the passphrase).

post.description: Adopt an app home from a drive with its encryption passphrase: unlock, wrap for silent unlock here, create the instance and start it. Ports allocate fresh on this machine.
